newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold languishes unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold languishes unchanged.

text.p: Hong Kong's bullion market ended essentially unchanged on Monday from its New York close in what traders described as a very quiet market. "Nothing happened today," said one European broker. "It was very quiet today."
"Gold traded within a US$1 and US$2 range all day," he said, adding that he expected bullion to range from US$378 to US$383 in the next few weeks, with little activity.
Another dealer said bullion prices moved in a very narrow range. "All eyes are on the stock market," he said.
Hong Kong bullion ended at US$381.10-US$381.50 an ounce on Monday against New York's close of US$381.00/50 on Friday, and Saturday's close in Hong Kong of $381.25/75.
Local gold ended HK$1 lower at HK$3,513 a tael.
